name: Preset-adjustable capacitor
summary: This form distinguishes a capacitor with a preset or trim adjustment.
description: This form distinguishes a capacitor with a preset or trim adjustment. A trim or preset adjustment sets the capacitive value for the documented circuit function. The setting interface is different from a continuous operator adjustment in ordinary use.
Identify the adjustment function and the circuit terminals. The component value, range and setting method belong in the equipment or component documentation.
readingNotes: State how the capacitance setting is specified and which terminals belong to the device.
A preset adjustment is different from an operator-controlled variable capacitor.
